jobs.description:
Experience in building applications for web, mobile, desktop, or gaming? You’ll be familiar with .NET by Microsoft. This open-source, cross-platform framework (compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux) supports various programming languages, including the ever-popular C#. Thanks to its high-performance runtime, consistent programming model, and extensive library of precoded solutions .NET enables us to incorporate performance, security, reliability, and productivity into our solutions. 

Pave the way for AI innovations, cloud adoption and digital transformation with Microsoft Azure’s suite of virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases. Problem-solving, collaboration with crossfunctional teams and designing scalable solutions are going to be your key skills as an Azure expert. You’ll also familiarise yourself with Azure Active Directory, monitoring tools, and cost management to deliver the continuous integration and delivery, as well as implementing security best practices, quality and compliance that Sopra Steria is known for.  

Our Developers specialise in application and software development while seamlessly integrating systems, so we never lose sight of our business goals. With an eye towards user experience and productivity, you’ll design, code, and test new functionalities while troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and keeping technical documentation in order. Our developers love to design and are always informed of the latest design trends. When fulfilling day-to-day tasks, you’ll always be ready with a solution when there’s a problem. You’ll also collaborate with other teams and never miss a detail so you can deliver solutions that meet Sopra Steria’s quality standards. 

 

Profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

• .NET
• Typescript
• API design
• Security
• Azure services (Azure Functions/App Services, Azure IoT Hub, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Services…)
• OO
• SOLID principles
• Design patterns 
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• Languages: English, and Dutch or French required

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager Industial & Technical Solutions
jobs.description:
HQ Antwerp | Coverage: Europe (with potential EMEA expansion)| Business Development Manager| Energy, Oil & Gas

About the Company
Our client is an international technology organization with a strong footprint across Europe. The company designs and delivers advanced software and hardware solutions for complex industrial environments in the oil & gas industry, helping customers operate safely, efficiently and in full regulatory compliance.

 

Your New Role
 
As Business Development Manager, you are responsible for driving new business growth across Europe. You focus on opening new doors, building long-term commercial relationships and developing a sustainable opportunity pipeline within large, complex organizations.
 
This is a pure new business role with a long-term perspective. You will work on strategic target accounts with lengthy investment cycles, where success depends on trust-building, market insight, and persistence rather than short-term wins.
 
You work closely with the Sales Manager and internal technical teams and operate in a hybrid model combining office-based work, customer visits and international travel.
 
Key Responsibilities

• Identify, approach and develop new customers and new opportunities across European markets
• Map target regions, industries and strategic accounts and define focused action plans
• Establish relationships with key decision-makers within complex organizations
• Build and manage a qualitative sales pipeline through continuous prospecting and follow-up
• Understand customer processes, strategic challenges and long-term investment roadmaps
• Prepare and deliver tailored presentations, demonstrations and commercial proposals
• Collaborate with internal engineering and solution teams to translate business needs into technical solutions
• Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events and conferences
• Maintain structured reporting and pipeline management through CRM tools
• Contribute to long-term growth strategy, forecasting and market development initiatives
 

Your Profile

• At least 3 years of experience in Business Development within a technical or industrial environment
• Educational background in engineering, industrial technology or IT, or equivalent technical-commercial experience
• Experience or affinity with industries such as energy, process industry, industrial systems or infrastructure is a plus
• Demonstrated ability to generate new business, open new accounts and build relationships from the ground up
• Strong hunter mentality with resilience and confidence in approaching senior stakeholders
• Comfortable operating in environments with long sales cycles and high-value investment projects
• Strong communication and presentation skills at executive and technical levels
• Languages: English and Dutch are mandatory; additional European languages (German or French) German is a plusWillingness to travel regularly (short, project-based trips)

Are you passionate about data and turning information into valuable business insights?

 

To strengthen our Business Intelligence team, we are looking for a SAP Data & Analytics Consultant. In this role, you will help shape our data-driven future by designing and implementing reporting and analytics solutions across the Joris Ide division.

Your responsibilities

• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analytics solutions within the SAP ecosystem.
• Translate business requirements into data models, queries, views, reports and dashboards.

Your profile

• You enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
• You take initiative and are eager to learn and explore new technologies.
• You have excellent communication skills and can translate business needs into technical solutions.

• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business Intelligence, including data modelling, master data management and ETL processes.
• You have strong knowledge of:
• SAP Business Data Cloud
• SAP Datasphere
• SAP Analytics Cloud
• Experience with SAP BusinessObjects, SAP BW and SAP HANA Views is considered a plus.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is an asset.Persoonsgebonden competenties (soft skills):
• Analyseren

• Initiatief
• Plannen en organiseren
• Samenwerken

An international company based in Zaventem is looking for an Allround Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. 

In this role, you will support a broad range of accounting activities, including invoice processing, bank bookings, reconciliations, monthly closing, reporting and audit support. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and contribute to improving accounting processes. Are you ready for the next step in your career? Don't hesitate to apply.

Your responsibilities:

• Process sales, purchase and general expense invoices in SAP.
• Perform daily bank bookings, reconciliations and account checks.
• Review and follow up on invoices, open items and DMS workflows.
• Process employee expense claims through SAP.
• Support monthly closing, reporting, accruals and reconciliations.
• Prepare documentation for audits and J-SOX requirements.
• Assist with fixed assets, stock counts and other accounting tasks.
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-processing questions.
• Contribute to process improvements.
• Provide back-up support to the wider accounting team when needed.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• At least 2 years of relevant accounting experience.
• Good knowledge of accounting principles.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• Good MS Office/Excel skills.
• Accurate, organized and detail-oriented.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and a strong team player.
• Fluent in English and good knowledge of French and Dutch.

The opportunity

Our Client designs, supports and maintains IT solutions for mission-critical operations at international customer sites — where conventional IT meets industrial operational technology, and reliability, clear communication and disciplined execution really matter. We're strengthening our Service Desk with an experienced Level 2 engineer who takes end-to-end ownership, collaborates across teams, keeps customers informed, and helps the whole support organization work more consistently and effectively.
What you'll do

• Own assigned incidents and service requests end-to-end — from acceptance through resolution, validation and documented closure

• Diagnose complex application, infrastructure, integration, database and OS issues using logs, traces and structured troubleshooting

• Restore service via remote or on-site intervention, respecting operational, security and change-control requirements

• Analyze problems, reproduce defects in lab/virtual environments, and collaborate with Development and DevOps on fixes

• Perform planned preventive and corrective maintenance, and support release validation and go-live readiness

• Maintain documentation, build knowledge articles, and drive continuous improvement across the support organization

Why join us

• Work on technically varied systems supporting real-time, mission-critical operations

• Combine IT, OT, customer interaction, troubleshooting, maintenance and improvement in one role

• Collaborate with experienced support, operations, development, DevOps and project teams

• Grow within an international technology group with a global customer footprint

• 3+ years of hands-on Level 2 (or equivalent) IT application/infrastructure support in a business-critical environment

• Strong troubleshooting across Windows and/or Linux, networks, services, logs, databases and distributed applications

• Experience with incident, request, problem and change practices in an ITIL-aligned organization

• Clear technical writing in English; working proficiency in French (must have) and Dutch

• Valid category B driving license; willing to travel to customer sites and join a compensated on-call rotation

 

Nice to have:

• Microsoft Server stack (Windows Server, IIS, SQL Server) and/or Linux/Unix administration

• Relational & NoSQL platforms: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch

• Integration, APIs, messaging & MicroServices (e.g. ActiveMQ, Apache Camel)

• Scripting/automation in Python, PowerShell, JavaScript or C#

• Experience in industrial IT/OT or other 24/7 operational environments; Jira & Confluence

 

The mindset we're looking for:

You take ownership rather than waiting for others to unblock a ticket, and you stay accountable until a sound handover or closure. You collaborate constructively, communicate calmly under pressure, and stay curious — turning lessons into documentation or automation. You troubleshoot methodically, respect procedures, and are reliable when it matters most.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
• Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Education and experience:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.
  
• Hard skills:
• Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
• Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
• Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
• Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
• Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)
  
• Soft skills:
• Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
• Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
• Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.
  
• Languages:
• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.

jobs.occupation: Cloud Engineer ( Data Science) | Proximus Ada
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Cloud Engineer with a strong background in DevOps, MLOps, and cloud architecture (Azure) to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in designing, deploying, and scaling cloud-based AI and data solutions, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and modern DevOps practices. Your expertise will help us deliver robust platforms and services for a wide range of client projects, ensuring security, scalability, and operational excellence.

• 
Fluent in English. Dutch and/or French is considered as a plus.

jobs.occupation: Manager Consolidation and Reporting - Walloon Brabant
jobs.description:
A European industrial group operating in multiple countries is reinforcing its Group Finance structure and is hiring a Manager / Head of Consolidation & Group Reporting.

The group works with complex operations, numerous entities and a strong international footprint, requiring robust reporting frameworks and high-quality consolidated financials.

Their offices are located in Walloon Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

You will lead the consolidation and reporting function, oversee IFRS compliance and safeguard the accuracy, consistency and timeliness of group accounts. As a key advisor to senior finance leadership, you will drive harmonisation of accounting practices and continuous improvement of the consolidation environment.

Key Responsibilities :

• Steer the monthly, quarterly and annual consolidation under IFRS
• Ensure quality and completeness of consolidated accounts (eliminations, minority interests, acquisitions/divestments…)
• Lead the preparation of the group's statutory financial statements and quarterly reporting
• Act as main point of contact for external auditors
• Manage and optimise the consolidation system (HFM or equivalent)
• Develop reporting structures, dashboards and closing-process improvements
• Support M&A activities (PPA, integration, system setup)
• Collaborate closely with FP&A, treasury and local accounting teams
• Possibility to manage one consolidation analyst (depending on experience).

• Master's degree in Finance/Accounting; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA…) is an asset
• 6-12 years of experience in Consolidation or External Audit within an international context
• Strong IFRS expertise and ability to handle complex accounting topics
• Rigorous, analytical and comfortable with tight deadlines
• Excellent communication with the ability to influence stakeholders across countries
• Fluent in English (French is a plus).

jobs.occupation: International Inside Sales - High-Performance Metal Industry
jobs.description:
Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Italian is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

jobs.occupation: Brand and Category Manager - FMCG - Confectionary company
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of well-established brands enjoyed by millions of consumers worldwide. Combining a rich heritage with a forward-thinking mindset, the company develops and markets high-quality products that are part of consumers' everyday lives.

With a significant international footprint, multiple production sites across several countries, and thousands of employees worldwide, the organization combines global scale with a strong local-market focus. Its success is driven by a deep understanding of consumer needs, continuous innovation, and a commitment to delivering products that consumers know, trust, and love.

The company offers a dynamic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment where employees are empowered to make an impact and contribute to the growth of iconic brands.

Jobomschrijving

The Brand & Category Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and driving the performance of the company's brands and product categories (sweet biscuits, chocolate, savoury).

This role leads the marketing strategy for the Belgium market, optimizes the product assortment, analyzes business performance, and ensures alignment between consumer needs, market trends, and business objectives, all while supporting the broader strategic vision of the group.Keys responsibilities and activities

Brand Management:

• Define and implement the annual marketing plan in terms of product portfolio, innovation, communication, consumer/shopper activation.
• Contribute to the preparation of the yearly marketing budget. Be responsible to follow up the spendings, making sure you stay aligned with the agreed yearly budget.
• Collaborate with the Netherlands, France, England and Turkey team on cross-border concepts, innovation launches. Recommend the relevant innovations and go-to market plan for Belgium market and prepare the launch plans.
• Manage the existing portfolio, including the potential updates driven by global teams and oversee the development of Point-of-Sale (POS) material.
• Implement the annual communication plan (social media, OOH and retail media campaigns).
• Implement and monitor the annual consumer/shopper activation's (consumer promotion, sampling, couponing campaign, Point Of Sale (POS) materials for field sale steam …)
• Analyse the activities results and take the conclusions into action plan and optimize investments and future strategies.
• Be in permanent contact with external agencies and internal stakeholders (production, logistics, finance, legal, marketing, new product development).
• Monitor and analyse brands and products performances.

Category Management:

• Analyse Categories to identify the growth drivers. Participate in key customer meetings to share the Category Perspective and insights.
• Analyse customer performances and shopper data to develop sharp sales argumentation for business review and customer presentations (Colruyt, Delhaize, Carrefour, Intermarché, HD).
• Guide and work closely with Sales teams to optimize brand plan execution.

• A bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in a commercial & marketing field.
• 4-6 years working experience in a similar role in FMCG sector.
• Strong analytical and project management skills and a feel for retail, sales, or marketing.
• You combine an analytical mind with creativity and present ideas clearly and convincingly.
• You speak French, Dutch & English.
• You are a sociable team player: flexible, driven, curious, and a strong communicator.
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
• Knowledge of Nielsen is required.

• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
